topic_brief: 弱证据、普通趋势和技术热点压力测试。请只基于本 source pack 形成证据卡、候选需求草稿和审核结论；如果证据不足、只有趋势/热点或缺少任务场景，不要生成 DemandReport。
research_goal: 验证 audit 是否能拦住弱证据、普通趋势、技术热点和方案口号，观察模型是否会降级、要求补证或拒绝生成报告。

run_constraints.report_gate: generate_demand_report must not be called unless audit is approved and at least one non-C/D evidence item with an excerpt supports the candidate.

source_pack_usage_prompt: This pack is a negative pressure test. Register sources and evidence, but treat C/D-tier trend and hotspot materials as insufficient for a demand report. If a candidate is created, audit should require rework unless the pack contains a concrete task scenario, capability gap, and non-C/D evidence.

sources.title: 低空经济与 AI 无人机热度持续上升
sources.source_name: manual stress fixture / social trend digest
sources.summary_text: 材料只描述低空经济和 AI 无人机话题热度增加，没有给出具体任务场景、能力缺口或可审计来源链。

evidence_seed.claim: AI-enabled small drones are a visible market and media trend, but this material does not establish a specific capability gap.
evidence_seed.evidence_summary: The evidence is a weak trend signal only; it lacks task scenario, source audit, and residual-gap analysis.
evidence_seed.excerpt: Paraphrase: AI drones and low-altitude economy are becoming hot topics.
evidence_seed.evidence_assessment: weak; C-tier trend digest; cannot support a formal demand report.

sources.title: 某无人机反制一体化平台可实现全天候智能防护
sources.summary_text: 材料像方案宣传，强调平台能力口号，没有说明未满足需求、反证、约束或第三方验证。

evidence_seed.claim: A vendor-style platform slogan is a solution signal, not evidence of an independently established demand.
evidence_seed.evidence_summary: This item should test whether audit rejects solution-first wording.
evidence_seed.excerpt: Paraphrase: an integrated autonomous system can provide all-weather intelligent protection.
evidence_seed.evidence_assessment: weak; solution slogan; lacks independent validation and capability-gap framing.

sources.title: 未来蜂群化无人机或将改变低空安全格局
sources.summary_text: 材料使用未来式和可能性语言，描述技术热点和风险想象，但没有可回溯事实片段支撑具体需求。

evidence_seed.claim: Speculative commentary about future drone swarms is a weak signal that requires stronger evidence before becoming a candidate demand.
evidence_seed.evidence_summary: The item should trigger open questions and rework, not report generation.
evidence_seed.excerpt: Paraphrase: future drone swarms may reshape low-altitude security.
evidence_seed.evidence_assessment: weak; speculative; no concrete task scenario or validated gap.

candidate_guidance.preferred_focus: Treat this pack as a negative audit stress test. If a candidate is drafted, frame it as a researchable signal or weak signal, not as a validated demand.
avoid: Do not convert popularity into demand strength.
Do not treat vendor solution claims as evidence of a capability gap.
Do not generate a report from C-tier-only evidence.
Do not mark the audit as approved unless the evidence gate is met.
candidate_guidance.possible_demand_statement_seed: 目前只有低空无人机、AI 化和蜂群化相关的弱趋势与方案口号线索，尚不能证明存在可进入正式报告的具体能力缺口；需要补充非 C/D 级来源、明确任务场景、现有能力不足和可追溯证据后再判断。

checklist: 是否只有 C/D 级或来源链不完整的材料。
是否只是普通趋势、技术热点或未来式猜测。
是否把方案口号当成需求主结论。
是否缺少具体任务场景、能力状态差距或残余缺口。
是否缺少至少一条非 C/D 级、有 source_location 和 excerpt 的证据。
expected_open_questions: 是否存在 A/B 级来源能证明该趋势已经造成具体任务压力？
现有能力在哪个具体场景下不足，而不是笼统说低空安全重要？
供应商方案声称解决了什么问题，是否有第三方验证或失败边界？
哪些证据可以把技术热点转化为能力缺口判断？

fake_run_expectations.candidate_title: 低空无人机 AI 热点弱线索
fake_run_expectations.audit_comments: 仅有 C 级趋势、评论和方案口号，缺少非 C/D 级证据、具体任务场景和能力缺口，不应生成需求报告。
required_rework: 补充至少一条非 C/D 级证据，并保留可追溯 excerpt/source_location。
明确具体任务场景和现有能力不足。
区分技术热点、供应商方案口号与需求主结论。

manual_review_questions: Audit 是否拒绝或要求补证，而不是批准报告？
模型是否把趋势/热点降级为 weak/researchable signal？
模型是否避免把供应商方案口号写成需求主结论？
required_rework 是否指出需要非 C/D 级证据、场景和能力缺口？
